title: Strategic Thinking and Planning
overview: An organization without a clear strategy is like a ship adrift without a rudder. To consistently deliver exceptional value to stakeholders and customers, organizations must have a well-defined direction and a plan to get there. This is where strategic thinking and planning become crucial. Strategy involves setting ambitious goals, understanding both the current and future environment, and charting a course for the organization's success. In this course, participants will explore the 7 steps of the strategic management process, starting with the 'thinking' phase, progressing through 'planning,' and culminating in 'execution.'
audience: This course is designed for managers and senior professionals who are responsible for influencing, formulating, or supporting the long-term planning and strategy of their department or organization.
methodology: Participants will engage in practical exercises that simulate the development of each step in the strategic management process. Acting as organizational managers, they will craft strategic components for a chosen organization. Key strategy tools and frameworks will be introduced, discussed, and applied throughout the course.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Apply strategic thinking to assess their current environment and define their organizational goals
Utilize the strategic management process to achieve desired objectives
Evaluate and select strategies that offer a sustainable competitive advantage
Develop strategic objectives, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and 'SMART' targets for their organization
Translate strategic plans into operational plans by creating and sequencing strategic initiatives
Engage in the performance management cycle to ensure successful strategy execution

items.text: Introduction to strategy and the strategic management process
Distinguishing between strategic thinking and strategic planning
The role of vision and mission statements
The three primary goals of competitive strategy
Innovating within the industry value chain
Ensuring strategic alignment within the organization
Identifying and implementing Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Criteria for creating effective action plans
Control processes and KPI dashboard reporting
